summary: A 23-month-old reported missing from home near the 1500 block of W. Highway 34 in Drake was found unresponsive about 400 yards downriver from the home; CPR was started, the child was transported to a hospital and pronounced dead; LCSO conducted the search.
notes: Missing-child search response ending in drowning; in scope as a documented SAR search with public reporting. Run 651.
